verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean bound is q ≤ 2τ + (2z²)^{1/(1-2h)} with τ = 1 - t, uniformly in r, where q = coordinateQ (2h) solves q - z²q^{2h} = τ. With CoordinateAlgebra.D h = 1/2 - h one has 1/D = 2/(1-2h), so (2z²)^{1/(1-2h)} = 2^{1/(1-2h)} |z|^{2/(1-2h)} = 2^{1/(1-2h)} |z|^{1/D}; taking C_0 = 2^{1/(1-2h)} (which is ≥ 2 for 0 < h < 1/2) gives exactly the paper's q ≤ C_0(τ + |z|^{1/D}). The paper's C_0 is an unspecified absolute constant, the Lean one is explicit, and only the upper half of the paper's ≍ is formalized here (the matching lower bounds live separately, e.g. LocalScaleGeometry.time_dist_le and axial_sq_le); the upper direction is the only one (10.3) asserts and the only one the proof of Proposition 10.1 uses.
